tierReasoning: Reversible repair of banner signal and send-time proof in an existing warning path; no new lifecycle authority or migration.

causalAutopsy.notes: Original fix rejected a captured provider banner and conditionally dropped the transport proof identity when evidence changed. Restore the signal and preserve identity through final proof validation.

guardEvidence.howCaught: The notify edge converges to one attempt per topic/provider UUID at N and 2N ticks, including restart. The durable pre-send reservation is the settling brake; serving replies carry a clear through transfer and a new UUID starts a distinct episode.
